text:
Caching made my app fast. Then it served stale data to thousands of users.

The cache wasn't broken — my invalidation strategy was.

Patterns that actually matter:

• Cache-aside — app reads cache first, loads DB on miss
• Write-through vs write-back — consistency vs speed
• TTL alone is not a strategy — know what "stale" means for your product
• Cache stampede — one hot key expiring can flatten your database

Invalidation is one of the two hard problems in CS for a reason.

New in my System Design series — the post I needed before turning on Redis in production.
